entities.name: Aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase
observations: Sequence query (350 aa) matches reviewed Corynebacterium homologs at 49.4% identity with 96.9% query coverage (E-value 5.6e-98).
Annotated activity: NADPH-dependent reductive dephosphorylation of L-aspartyl-4-phosphate to L-aspartate-semialdehyde; EC 1.2.1.11, Rhea RHEA:24284.
Homolog annotations place the enzyme in lysine, methionine, and threonine biosynthesis from aspartate.

entities.name: Aspartate-family amino-acid biosynthesis
observations: Aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase supplies L-aspartate-semialdehyde, an intermediate feeding lysine, methionine, and threonine biosynthetic branches.
